use IO.Std.write_line

let minus_infinity = double.negative_infinity

struct TROPICAL(value: double) is
    ⊕(other: TROPICAL) -> TROPICAL =>
        TROPICAL(if value > other.value then value else other.value fi)

    ⊗(other: TROPICAL) -> TROPICAL => TROPICAL(value + other.value)

    ^(power: int) -> TROPICAL =>
        assert power > 0 else "exponent must be positive" in
        TROPICAL(value * cast(power))

    to_string() -> string =>
        if double.is_negative_infinity(value) then "-Inf"
        else "{value}"
        fi
si

let zero = TROPICAL(minus_infinity)
let one = TROPICAL(0.0D)

show(text: string, result: TROPICAL) =>
    write_line("{text} is {result}")

show("2 ⊗ -2", TROPICAL(2.0D) ⊗ TROPICAL(-2.0D))
show("-0.001 ⊕ -Inf", TROPICAL(-0.001D) ⊕ zero)
show("0 ⊗ -Inf", one ⊗ zero)
show("1.5 ⊕ -1", TROPICAL(1.5D) ⊕ TROPICAL(-1.0D))
show("-0.5 ⊗ 0", TROPICAL(-0.5D) ⊗ one)
show("5 ^ 7", TROPICAL(5.0D) ^ 7)

let a = TROPICAL(5.0D)
let b = TROPICAL(8.0D)
let c = TROPICAL(7.0D)

show("5 ⊗ (8 ⊕ 7)", a ⊗ (b ⊕ c))
show("5 ⊗ 8 ⊕ 5 ⊗ 7", a ⊗ b ⊕ a ⊗ c)

        else "{value}"
        fi

let zero = TROPICAL(minus_infinity)
let one = TROPICAL(0.0D)

show(text: string, result: TROPICAL) =>
    write_line("{text} is {result}")

show("2 ⊗ -2", TROPICAL(2.0D) ⊗ TROPICAL(-2.0D))
show("-0.001 ⊕ -Inf", TROPICAL(-0.001D) ⊕ zero)
show("0 ⊗ -Inf", one ⊗ zero)
